kamloops.title: Arson investigations launched for some B.C. fires as wildfires continue to burn
kamloops.description: The Columbia Shuswap Regional District said RCMP are investigating three fires in a ditch on Squilax Anglemont Road that were reported around 5:30 p.m. on Wednesday.

kamloops.title: Ottawa sells 10 retired military planes to convert for aerial firefighting
kamloops.description: The announcement comes amid growing calls for Canada to update and expand its fleet of firefighting aircraft as it contends with another devastating wildfire season.

kamloops.title: Okanagan resident says flames were surrounding their house as they fled
kamloops.description: They had just minutes to escape their property on the Benchland above Okanagan Lake when the Bradley Lake wildfire tore through the property.

cariboo.title: Small B.C. community surrounded by wildfires facing more ER closures
cariboo.description: The emergency room department at 100 Mile District General Hospital is closed from 7 a.m. to 8 p.m. on Friday and is expected to be closed for the same stretch on Sunday.

all.title: Fire and Climate – a special and timely collection
all.description: The 2026 wildfire season shows us that with increased wildland fire risk, more intense fire behaviour, longer seasons, and fire evolving across many landscapes, a changing climate poses significant challenges to today’s fire regimes and management strategies.
